name: notion-shell
description: Portable Notion-style wrapper primitives (Page / Header / Sidebar / Block / Database / Property). Pure / props-driven; pair with notion-blocks for editor primitives.
notes: Lifted from notion-page-clone/frontend/shared/components/notion. Cover + icon-picker dependencies intentionally stripped — host provides `renderIcon` + `renderIconPicker` props (pair with @/features/icon-picker for full Lucide support). NotionBlock dispatches via `blockRenderers` prop (host owns the registry).
